SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ...... REGISTRY
S.I, Special Branch. 417
REPORT
Date October 7, 1940. 40
Subject (in full) Premises at 118 Route Pere Robert, French Concession.
Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih, Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

Premises at No. 118 Route Pere Robert were
formerly occupied by the Italian Embassy but following
the outbreak of the European War the Embassy was
removed to the Consulate premises at Chengtu and
Bubbling Well Roads. The premises were then occupied
by the French Military Supplies Department until 6th
October 1940 when the Japanese Gendarmerie took over
the premises. The French Military Supplies Department
is now at 75 Route Frelupt. House No. 118 Route Pere
Robert it is reported is the property of the compradore
of the M.B.K.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 6 OCT. 1940）

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

档案编号 ...... 登记处
S.I, 特别支部。 417
报告
日期 1940年10月7日。 40
完整事由 法租界罗别根路 (Route Pere Robert) 118号处所。
撰写人 督察潘连璧 (Pan Lien-pih)，转呈人 督察克劳福德 (Crawford)。

罗别根路 (Route Pere Robert) 118号的处所此前由意大利大使馆占用，但随着欧洲战争的爆发，该使馆已迁至成都路 (Chengtu Road) 和静安寺路 (Bubbling Well Road) 的领事馆处所。随后该处所由法国军需部占用，直至1940年10月6日日本宪兵队接管该处所。法国军需部现位于弗雷吕普路 (Route Frelupt) 75号。据报，罗别根路 (Route Pere Robert) 118号房产为麦加利银行 (M.B.K.) 买办的财产。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处总监办公室 1940年10月6日）
